scope: Four bounded working gestures/gaze bridges only; complete companion experience remains in production.

evidence.judgement: Actual authored-time browser playback and stopped-frame inspection: recognizable unchanged character, stable body/laptop/stool, subtle readable finger contacts, no visible endpoint jump between these four packages. Eye direction uses genuine screen/neutral drawings. No deformation or crossfade synthesized motion.
evidence.limitations: Acceptance is for these small actions and gaze transitions, not a long repeated living work loop, large posture changes, or drag/landing.
